stories.title: Duran to Phillies! Seager to Rays! Trades we want to see before baseball shuts down
stories.summary: An MLB lockout is looming. Our experts suggest some last-minute deals.

stories.title: Did Mets just win NL East? How Tarik Skubal raises New York's 2027 projections
stories.summary: Only one team could land MLB's biggest free agent. Here's what that means for the Mets.

stories.title: Sources: Cubs continue spending spree, add 2-time Japanese MVP Sato for $120M
stories.summary: The Cubs reached a 6-year, $120 million agreement with Japanese INF/OF Teruaki Sato on Tuesday, sources told ESPN's Jeff Passan.

stories.title: Alberts told he won't be next AD at Michigan, attorney says
stories.summary: Trev Alberts has been informed by the search firm representing Michigan that he will not be the Wolverines' next athletic director, attorney Tom Mars told ESPN.

stories.title: Sources: Peralta stays in AL East, gets $125M deal to top Orioles rotation
stories.summary: Freddy Peralta has agreed to a five-year, $125M deal with the Orioles, who have landed an ace starter after losing Trevor Rogers, sources told ESPN.
